name: How long does high-pressure drain jetting take?

mainEntity.name: How long does high-pressure drain jetting take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of high-pressure drain jetting depends on several factors, including the severity and location of the blockage, the length and diameter of the pipe, and the overall condition of your plumbing system. A typical residential drain jetting service might take anywhere from one to a few hours. Before beginning, a plumber will often perform a camera inspection to assess the blockage and pipe condition, which helps determine the estimated time required for the job and ensures the most effective approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: The time for drain jetting varies based on blockage severity, pipe length, and condition, typically ranging from one to a few hours. A pre-service camera inspection helps determine the exact timeframe.
